description: This PHP class defines an OpenCart admin controller extension for managing the 'Free Checkout' payment method. It includes methods for displaying the configuration form ('index') and saving settings ('save'), along with loading dependencies and rendering views.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: OpenCart admin controller extension for the 'Free Checkout' payment method, allowing configuration and saving of settings within the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the 'Free Checkout' payment method, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the 'Free Checkout' method, including permission checks and JSON response.
